{{Quote|Ah, it's just a low-grade flesh-eating virus. Makes Zabraks' horns fall out. Embarrassing, not life-threatening.|Doc|<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />}}
'''Zabrak Scalp Necrosis''' was a relatively low-grade flesh-eating virus that afflicted the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The virus, which caused its victims' cranial horns to fall out, was cured when a [[Unidentified Republic doctor|doctor]] developed a vaccine for it. The fame the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] gained from the achievement led to his appointment as acting head of the [[Republic Health Administration]].<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zabrak Scalp Necrosis was mentioned in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', during the conversation "Opportunity Knocks" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class' companion character [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]].<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />
